text:
**Best fit: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200W solar panels.** It’s a well-matched kit for the 2,000Wh class: **2,042Wh capacity, 2,200W output, and 400W of included panels**. [Generator & Backup calls it its most complete solar-backup kit](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup).

If you expect to add panels or batteries later, consider the **EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max with two 220W panels** instead: it supports up to 1,000W of solar input and can expand to 6kWh. Actual panel output will vary with sun, angle, and season. [Compare the EcoFlow and Jackery kits](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup).

judge.why: The answer recommends a Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 kit and an EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max kit, neither of which we sell, and it cites only generatorandbackup.com, not dealectric.com.
